about: E54 window geometry, its second half (the plan W3): the slider scaling of a window box moves out of settings.mjs into window-scale.mjs - after the behaviour commits W2 (registerWindows hands scaleWindow its readers; before it the half read sliderScale, layoutHeight and settingsRegistered, which settings.mjs keeps, and split.mjs refused it, F2) and Q-E54-7 (the sheet heights actionsTabHeight and callsHeight). A file of its own, not windows.mjs, because W1 writes windows.mjs from utils.mjs and split.mjs refuses a target that exists: the owner question is whether one windows.mjs is wanted, which needs split.mjs to append. Run after windows.json: node tools/e54/split.mjs --manifest tools/e54/windows-settings.json, then node tools/e54/repoint.mjs --manifest tools/e54/windows-settings.json.
facadeNote: E54 (the plan W3): the slider scaling of a window box (`scaleWindow`, `registerWindows`, the memo and the boxes, the sheet heights) lives in window-scale.mjs, re-exported here; this file keeps the settings.

header: The slider scaling of a module window box (E54, the plan W3): `registerWindows` stands `scaleWindow` on the two render
hooks with the readers module.mjs hands it (the slider, the layout height, whether the settings are registered), the
memo that keeps a re-render from compounding the scale (`scaleMemo`), the box a window asks for scaled and held on
the screen (`scaledBox`, `sheetBox`), and the sheet heights (`actionsTabHeight`, `callsHeight`, Q-E54-7). Moved out of
settings.mjs, which re-exports what it exported. windows.mjs (W1) holds the width that shows a table.

repoint.about: tools/e54/repoint.mjs part for this cut (sheet.json repoint says what each field is).
